You are rebuilding one page of the **Акции Nyxa** template, a promo site (angle: everyday). Keep the section order, the content and every rule in the brief. Write the page text exactly as given (it is in Russian); write code and comments in English. If something in the brief is missing or unclear, ask instead of guessing, and never invent claims, figures, offers or reviews.

**Target stack:** WordPress with the SX ACF blocks (`sx/<block>` from `wp/sx-blocks.php`). If you use another stack (plain HTML/CSS, React/Next.js, another CMS), build one component per section with the listed fields as props.

## Acceptance checklist

- [ ] Sections appear in the order given, with the same layout variant (or an equivalent layout).
- [ ] All text is used exactly as given; nothing invented (no extra claims, figures, offers or reviews).
- [ ] One H1 per page; headings do not skip levels.
- [ ] No horizontal scrolling at 375px; tap targets at least 44px.
- [ ] Each page is under 64 KB of HTML and CSS (images excluded).
- [ ] The structured data listed for each page is present and valid.
- [ ] Every internal link opens an existing page.
- [ ] Text contrast meets WCAG AA, focus is visible, images have alt text.
- [ ] Every rule in the market guidance and the block rules holds on every page.

# Rebuild brief: Акции Nyxa

_Follow the system prompt (role, target stack, acceptance checklist) together with this brief._

## Site type guidance

- Purpose: show the current offers and their terms in plain words; the lead offer comes first.
- Every offer shows its value, its code (or "no code needed"), two key terms, the date it was verified and a link to the full terms.
- Never show an expired offer or one that is not valid yet; the build refuses a page with no live offer.
- Offer types the market restricts are not shown at all.
- Code boxes copy the code with one tap and show feedback.

## Market guidance

### Market context (from the market settings)

- Market: Demoland (demo only) (`xx`), languages en, ru, pt, currency EUR (€)
- Minimum age: 18+
- Products allowed: sports, casino
- Promotions allowed: welcome_bonus, deposit_bonus, free_bets, promo_code, odds_boost, cashback, loyalty, tournaments
- Payment methods: Visa Debit, Mastercard Debit, Apple Pay, Банковский перевод
- App install paths: iOS app-store, Android play

### Mandated texts (from the market settings)

- Age notice: Только 18+. Действуют условия предложений.
- Licence: Лицензия
- Self-exclusion: Самоисключение и лимиты депозита доступны в каждом аккаунте.

### Rules you must not break

- Every page opens with an age gate (18+) before any gambling content.
- Every page has the responsible-gambling panel (usually in the footer) with the market text: age notice, licence line, taglines, self-exclusion and helpline where given. Never type this text yourself; it comes from the market settings.
- Minimum age is 18: the age gate and every age line say 18+.
- Show only these payment methods: Visa Debit, Mastercard Debit, Apple Pay, Банковский перевод.
- Amounts are in EUR (€).

### Market-specific rules

- DEMO-ONLY market: never ship it to a real site; the build refuses it unless the config has "demo": true.

## Site context

- Site: Акции Nyxa, brand or publisher: Nyxa
- Site type: promo, angle everyday; language `ru`, text direction `ltr`

## Design tokens

Fonts (Google Fonts): Inter, JetBrains Mono.

Layout is mobile-first: it must work from 375px to 1440px wide.

## Block rules

- Responsible gambling: All copy comes from markets/<id>.json; never type compliance text into a page.
- Responsible gambling: Every page renders a 'panel' (usually inside the footer). 'strip' is an optional top-of-page addition.
- Responsible gambling: Where a market lists several mandated taglines, one is chosen per site by seed.
- Header: One-page landing and app pages use 'minimal' (no nav) so attention stays on the conversion.
- Header: The CTA stays visible at every width; on mobile the nav collapses into a menu, the CTA does not.
- Offer hero: Value, code, two key terms and Claim above the fold at 375x667.
- Offer hero: Offer value, code and terms come only from brands/promotions/<brand>.json; content may only add a headline and subtitle.
- Offer hero: No countdowns, no click-to-reveal; the verified date is always shown.
- Trust bar: Values come from brand facts and market config; nothing is typed by hand.
- Trust bar: Rating shows only when the brand has facts.rating_source.
- Trust bar: Sits directly under the hero (section 2 or 3).
- Steps: Exactly 3 steps; numbers are used because the order is real.
- Steps: Mention verification and deposit limits honestly; do not promise instant approval.
- Offer terms: Terms come from the promotion feed only. Never collapsed by default; never in small print.
- Promo list: Never above the lead offer. Each promo shows value, code or 'no code', two key terms and its verified date.
- FAQ: 4-6 questions: legality in the country, deposits/withdrawals, payout time, verification, limits or self-exclusion.
- FAQ: Answers are plain text, 1-3 sentences. No CTA links inside answers.
- Final CTA: Always the last section before the footer.
- Final CTA: Headline 40 characters max. No urgency claims (timers, 'last chance').
- Footer: Always renders the compliance panel; it cannot be switched off.
- Footer: Payment methods come from the market config so they are always locally correct.
- Age gate: Age comes from the market (21 in KZ, 18 in AU/BR). Never hard-code it.
- Age gate: Content stays in the HTML for crawlers; the overlay is shown by script, so no-JS users still see the compliance footer.
- Sticky CTA: Phones only (860px and narrower). Never covers the compliance panel: the footer gets bottom padding.
- Sticky CTA: Shows the market age badge next to the CTA.

## Page

- Title tag: Акции Nyxa: повышенные коэффициенты, кешбэк и турниры
- Meta description: Все текущие акции Nyxa с условиями простыми словами: +30% к коэффициентам на live, кешбэк 15% в неделю и турнир по слотам на €10 000. 18+.
- The only H1: Буст Nyxa: +30% к коэффициентам на live каждый вечер
- Structured data (JSON-LD): WebPage, FAQPage

### Sections, in order

1. **Responsible gambling** — block `sx/compliance-bar`, variant `strip`, role `compliance`
   Purpose: Market-driven responsible gambling notice: age, licence line, taglines, self-exclusion, helpline.
   - `show_verify`: false
2. **Header** — block `sx/header`, variant `minimal-split`, role `header`
   Purpose: Site header with logo, navigation and primary CTA.
   - `sticky`: false
   - `show_cta`: true
3. **Offer hero** — block `sx/offer-hero`, variant `split-offer`, role `hero`
   Purpose: Lead promotion: value, code with copy, two key terms, Claim, verified date. Data from the brand promotion feed.
   - `title`: "Буст Nyxa: +30% к коэффициентам на live каждый вечер"
   - `subtitle`: "Код не нужен. Повышенные коэффициенты появляются на отдельных live-рынках футбола и хоккея с 18:00."
4. **Trust bar** — block `sx/trust-bar`, variant `badges`, role `trust`
   Purpose: Licence, payout time, years operating, local payments and (only if sourced) rating.
   - `items`: `["licence","payout","since","payments"]`
5. **Steps** — block `sx/steps`, variant `timeline`, role `content`
   Purpose: Three real steps from sign-up to first bet, followed by the mid-page CTA.
   - `eyebrow`: "Как это работает"
   - `title`: "Ставка по повышенному коэффициенту"
   - `items`: `[{"title":"Войдите или зарегистрируйтесь","text":"Бусты доступны верифицированным клиентам. Проверка обычно занимает несколько минут."},{"title":"Откройте вкладку «Бусты»","text":"С 18:00 повышенные рынки отмечены значком огня. Показанный коэффициент уже включает буст."},{"title":"Сделайте ординар","text":"Ставка до €25 на каждый рынок с бустом. Если ещё не поставили лимит депозита, сделайте это заранее."}]`
   - `show_cta`: true
6. **Offer terms** — block `sx/promo-terms`, variant `checklist`, role `content`
   Purpose: Every significant term of the lead offer, in plain words, with a link to the full T&Cs.
   - `intro`: "Полные правила буста."
7. **Promo list** — block `sx/promo-list`, variant `list`, role `content`
   Purpose: Other active, allowed promotions from the feed, below the lead offer. Renders nothing when there are none.
   - `include_lead`: false
   - `show_codes`: true
   - `mobile`: "stack"
   - `limit`: "0"
8. **FAQ** — block `sx/faq`, variant `columns`, role `content`
   Purpose: Answers the objections that stop sign-ups. Emits FAQPage structured data.
   - `items`: `[{"q":"Нужен ли код для бустов?","a":"Нет. Повышенные коэффициенты показываются верифицированным клиентам автоматически. Код нужен только для турнира по слотам (LANTERN)."},{"q":"Как считается кешбэк?","a":"15% от чистого проигрыша в казино с понедельника по воскресенье, но не больше €75. Начисляется в понедельник и отыгрывается один раз."},{"q":"Можно ли совместить буст с другими акциями?","a":"Повышенный коэффициент нельзя использовать в экспрессе или вместе с другой акцией на коэффициенты на том же рынке."},{"q":"Как участвовать в турнире?","a":"Введите код LANTERN в разделе «Акции» и играйте в слоты Paper Lantern Games со ставкой до €5 за спин до 30 ноября 2026."}]`
9. **Final CTA** — block `sx/cta-band`, variant `split`, role `content`
   Purpose: The last push before the footer: short headline, the CTA and two proof points.
   - `title`: "Вечерние бусты стартуют в 18:00"
   - `text`: "Код не нужен. Верифицированные клиенты, 18+."
   - `show_code`: true
10. **Footer** — block `sx/footer`, variant `compact`, role `footer`
   Purpose: Footer with links, payment methods, the compliance panel and copyright.
   - `show_verify`: false
  - inside it: **Responsible gambling** — block `sx/compliance-bar`, variant `panel`
     - `show_verify`: false
11. **Age gate** — block `sx/age-gate`, variant `split`, role `age-gate`
   Purpose: Age confirmation overlay using the market's minimum age. Remembers the answer for 30 days.
   - `leave_url`: "https://www.google.com"
   - `preview`: false
12. **Sticky CTA** — block `sx/sticky-cta`, variant `code-bar`, role `sticky`
   Purpose: Bottom CTA on phones. Appears once the hero CTA scrolls away; hides while the final CTA is on screen.

_Long text and lists are shortened here (…, "[n items]"). For the full text run `php build/ai-brief.php sites/demos/<config>.json`._
